messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal public‑holiday long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023. (If you’re interested in provincial holidays that also create long weekends, let me know and I can add those too.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if moved) | Long‑weekend status |
|---------|--------------|---------------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | ✔️ |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | ✔️ |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | ✔️ |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | ✔️ |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | ✔️ |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | ✔️ |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | — | ✔️ |

**Notes**

* **Good Friday** (April 7) and **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) do not create long weekends because they fall on a Friday and a Tuesday, respectively.  
* Some provinces observe additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario on Feb 20, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17, etc.). If you need those provincial long weekends, just let me know!
